Specialization.Name: Gunner (reSpecialized) 1.1
Specialization.Description: [H4]Gunner (reSpecialized)[h4] [B]GUNNER—PITHY DESCRIPTION[b][BR] [B]At a Glance[b][BR] The Gunner should be the expert at using vehicle based weaponry to tackle the opponents whether it be the main gun of a tank, the turret of a starfighter, or a capital ship turbolaser.[BR] [B]All-in or Hybrid?[b][BR] ⅓ using heavy and Gunnery weapons as a precision “space sniper", ⅓ using gunnery weapons as a bombastic " heavy”, ⅓ being Tanky, but not armored..[BR] [B]What Should it be the Best At?[b][BR] Gunnery. These guys should be able to bullseye a womp rat without a targeting computer.[BR] Bombing runs. The Gunner should be the best combat bomber.[BR] [B]What should it be just “good” at?[b][BR] Ranged Heavy and other “heavy weapons” outside of a ship[BR] Being tanky[BR] [B]Specs for Comparison / Inspiration[b][BR] [I]Racer[i](Should be the inverse with Racer being mostly about movement and using the vehicle itself offensively, the Gunner should be all about weapons and barely any actual piloting or driving)[BR] [I]Heavy[i](The Gunner should be more about specific ship combat and less about personal-scale combat.)[BR] [I]Rigger[i](Treats their vehicle like a character, where this tree treats the party mascot like a vehicle. Similarities in tone)[BR] [B]Media Touchstones[b][BR] Any scenes with the Falcon’s gunner positions; Tobias Beckett, Han, Luke, Finn etc[BR] Baze Malbus (Rogue One)[BR] Wrecker (The Bad Batch)[BR]
